title: Not metallic,  not gold and silver. Think mud and gray.
text:
Not metallic, not gold and silver. Think mud and gray.. Wow... these are listed as being gold and silver papers. I received mine today. The ones I got were like kraft paper (paper sack) brown and gray. Not metallic, not shiny, nothing special.

I don't know if I got a bad batch or if these are just misrepresented. Would not buy again.
